verdict.rationale: Docs show broad API coverage for card/expense management, budgets, virtual cards, transactions, reimbursements, org structure, approvals, and vendor management (docs-2,5,7,9,39), suggesting strong UI/API parity, but there's no explicit claim of full feature parity and the OpenAPI spec is not discoverable (probe-2 shows 404s across standard paths), raising doubt about completeness/documentation of every endpoint. missing for 10: explicit 1:1 parity statement covering every S&E UI feature, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent/hands-on corroboration that all UI actions are API-reachable.
